boiler_controller.title: Setup Boiler Controller
boiler_controller.description: Set up the Boiler Controller integration.

power_sensor.title: Choose Power Sensor Type
power_sensor.description: Pick how grid power is reported in Home Assistant. A net (signed) sensor is one entity that goes negative when exporting. A split setup uses two separate sensors for return (export) and usage (import).

power_sensor_net.title: Select Net Power Sensor
power_sensor_net.description: Choose a single sensor that reports net grid power (negative when exporting to the grid). If a Powerbaas P1 Meter is set up, its Power Usage sensor is preselected.

power_sensor_split.title: Select Return and Usage Sensors
power_sensor_split.description: Choose two separate sensors: one for power returned to the grid and one for power drawn from the grid. Both should always be 0 or positive.

device_config.title: Configure BC Module
device_config.description: Enter the URL or IP address of your BC module (e.g. {example_url}). Auto-discovered devices will pre-fill this field.

airco_bridge.title: Setup Airco Bridge
airco_bridge.description: Set up the Airco Bridge integration.

airco_device_config.title: Configure Airco Bridge
airco_device_config.description: Enter the URL or IP address of your Airco Bridge (e.g. {example_url}). Auto-discovered devices will pre-fill this field.

rgb_device_config.description: Enter the URL or IP address of your Powerbaas RGB (e.g. {example_url}). Auto-discovered devices will pre-fill this field.

battery_priority.title: Battery and Safety Margin
battery_priority.description:
Do you have a home battery? Then the battery charges first: in Auto mode the boiler only uses the solar surplus the battery can't take, and backs off as soon as the battery discharges. You'll pick the battery's sensors in the next step.

The safety margin applies with or without a battery.

data_description.battery_sensor_type: How your battery's power shows up in Home Assistant: one sensor that is positive while charging and negative while discharging, or two separate sensors (one for charging, one for discharging). No battery? Choose 'No home battery'.
data_description.safety_margin_watts: The boiler always leaves this many watts of surplus unused. That way it never draws from the grid for a moment when a cloud passes, while it is still turning down. 50 W is a good start; 0 W uses all surplus.

battery_sensor_net.title: Select Battery Power Sensor
battery_sensor_net.description: Choose the sensor reporting the battery's power. By default charging is expected to be positive and discharging negative; enable the toggle if your battery reports it the other way round.

data_description.battery_power_sensor: The sensor with the battery's current power: positive while charging, negative while discharging.
data_description.battery_charge_negative: Turn on if your battery reports charging as a negative value instead.
data_description.battery_soc_sensor: Optional. The sensor showing how full the battery is, in %. Without it the boiler only gets surplus once the battery charges at its max power or stops taking more.
data_description.battery_full_soc: From this charge level the battery counts as full and the boiler gets the full surplus. Match it to the charge limit set in your battery (often 90-100%).
data_description.battery_max_charge_watts: The most your battery charges with, in watts (e.g. 800 W). Surplus up to this amount is reserved for the battery first.

battery_sensor_split.title: Select Battery Charge and Discharge Sensors
battery_sensor_split.description: Choose two separate sensors: one for the power going into the battery (charging) and one for the power coming out of it (discharging). Both should always be 0 or positive.

data_description.battery_charge_sensor: The sensor with the power going into the battery (charging), always 0 or positive.
data_description.battery_discharge_sensor: The sensor with the power coming out of the battery (discharging), always 0 or positive.
data_description.battery_soc_sensor: Optional. The sensor showing how full the battery is, in %. Without it the boiler only gets surplus once the battery charges at its max power or stops taking more.
data_description.battery_full_soc: From this charge level the battery counts as full and the boiler gets the full surplus. Match it to the charge limit set in your battery (often 90-100%).
data_description.battery_max_charge_watts: The most your battery charges with, in watts (e.g. 800 W). Surplus up to this amount is reserved for the battery first.

power_temp_sensors.title: Manage sensors
power_temp_sensors.description: Pick a sensor to rename, calibrate, disable or remove. Newly detected sensors show up under Settings → System → Repairs instead.

power_temp_sensor.title: Sensor on port {port}
power_temp_sensor.description: The offset is added to every reading (calibration). A disabled sensor is still read but never raises a warning, alarm or missing status. Removing a sensor that's still plugged in turns it back into a newly detected sensor.

boiler_controller_offline.title: Boiler Controller unreachable
boiler_controller_offline.description: The Boiler Controller module for "{name}" hasn't responded to several status checks in a row and is considered offline. Its sensors and controls will show as unavailable until it responds again. Check its power and WiFi connection - this will clear automatically once it's reachable.

p1_meter_offline.title: P1 Meter unreachable
p1_meter_offline.description: The Powerbaas P1 meter "{name}" hasn't responded to several data requests in a row and is considered offline. Its sensors will show as unavailable until it responds again. Check its power and network connection - this will clear automatically once it's reachable.

airco_bridge_offline.title: Airco Bridge unreachable
airco_bridge_offline.description: The Airco Bridge "{name}" hasn't responded to several status checks in a row and is considered offline. Its climate entity and sensors will show as unavailable until it responds again. Check its power and WiFi connection - this will clear automatically once it's reachable.

rgb_offline.title: Powerbaas RGB unreachable
rgb_offline.description: The Powerbaas RGB "{name}" hasn't responded to several status checks in a row and is considered offline. Its light entity and sensors will show as unavailable until it responds again. Check its power and WiFi connection - this will clear automatically once it's reachable.

power_temp_offline.title: Powerbaas PowerTemp unreachable
power_temp_offline.description: The Powerbaas PowerTemp "{name}" hasn't responded to several status checks in a row and is considered offline. Its temperature sensors will show as unavailable until it responds again. Check its power and WiFi connection - this will clear automatically once it's reachable.
